{{Otheruses|Operations Chief}}
The '''Army Operations Chief''' was the second highest position within the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military's]] [[Army Operations]], part of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station's]] command structure. Prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the position was held by [[Trech Molock/Legends|Trech Molock]], who often got into intense, private arguments with his superior, [[High General]] [[Cassio Tagge/Legends|Cassio Tagge]].
